build_gan_discriminator: build a SimpleDiscriminator GAN discriminator model with 128 feature filters and two ResNet blocks
create_resnet_block: create a ResnetBlock with configurable input output channels and optional learned shortcut convolution
run_discriminator_forward: run the SimpleDiscriminator forward pass on a batch of 3-channel image tensors
test_resnet_block_forward: test the ResnetBlock forward pass with matching or mismatched input and output channel dimensions
review_actvn_function: review the actvn function which applies ReLU activation to input tensors
